source_name: Prozorro / OpenProcurement public API (UA-EDR identifier scheme)
why_relevant: Machine-readable source of tenders and awards where supplier identity is carried under the 'UA-EDR' identifier scheme — the join key that makes company-intelligence platforms work. Enables building our own supplier-history index without licence constraints.

source_name: Zakupki.prom.ua — 'Аналіз постачальників' guidance and marketplace supplier data
why_relevant: Prom-group marketplace's methodology for analysing potential competitors in a procurement, plus access to its own supplier views. Useful both as method and as an alternate vendor-profile surface.

source_name: awesome835 — curated index of Ukrainian open-data tools and registries
why_relevant: Community-maintained list of every Ukrainian open-data registry, standard and tool. High-value snowballing seed for finding smaller aggregators and registry mirrors this cell has not yet enumerated.

source_name: АМКУ — Оскарження публічних закупівель (розділ органу оскарження)
why_relevant: Landing section of the Antimonopoly Committee of Ukraine acting as the statutory procurement review body (орган оскарження). Hosts the Permanent Administrative Board's reasoned decisions, generalised practice notes and activity reports — the richest public restatement of contested tender specifications, bidder names and price offers, including banking/payments equipment lots.

source_name: АМКУ — Комісія (колегія) з розгляду скарг: склад, регламент, звіти про діяльність
why_relevant: Names the sitting board members, procedural rules and publishes periodic activity reports with statistics on complaint volumes and outcomes — needed to interpret decision streams and to identify who decides contested banking-equipment awards.

source_name: АМКУ — повідомлення щодо оприлюднення рішень адмінколегії з розгляду скарг
why_relevant: Official notice explaining WHERE and in what form complaint decisions are published (Prozorro electronic system vs AMCU site) — the key document for designing a reliable collection pipeline for the appeals stream.

source_name: Prozorro Central Database API — complaint objects on tenders/awards
why_relevant: Complaints filed with the AMCU appeals body are attached as structured `complaints` objects to tender/award/qualification records in the Prozorro API, with status, dates, texts and attached documents. This is the only machine-readable, CPV-filterable route into the appeals stream for banking/payments tenders (ATMs, POS, cards, processing).
Defines the complaint schema, statuses and lifecycle used across Prozorro — essential for parsing and for distinguishing customer-level (замовник) complaints from those escalated to the AMCU board.

source_name: Data.gov.ua — Звіт про результати діяльності Держаудитслужби (моніторинг закупівлі, перевірка закупівель), форма 2-дфк
why_relevant: Structured open dataset of DASU activity results including procurement monitoring and procurement inspections — gives volumes, violation counts and recoveries, usable as a denominator/context layer for individual banking-sector findings.

The unified court register publishes full texts of decisions in all commercial and administrative cases — including challenges to DASU monitoring conclusions, appeals against AMCU board decisions, and contract disputes over ATM/POS/processing supply. Judgments restate technical specs, prices and bidder identities in detail.

source_name: Data.gov.ua / ДСА — річні відкриті дані ЄДРСР (bulk dumps)
why_relevant: State Judicial Administration publishes per-year bulk datasets of the court register, refreshed daily for the current year. This is the practical way to mine procurement-dispute judgments at scale without scraping the register UI.

source_name: Опендатабот — API ЄДРСР та судовий пошук
why_relevant: Commercial/registration-gated API over the unified court register plus company linkage — practical for automated monitoring of procurement litigation involving named banks, integrators and vendors without maintaining bulk infrastructure.

Legal-analytics layer over the court register with better search, case tracking and legal-position clustering; useful to find leading precedents on DASU-conclusion challenges and AMCU decision review affecting payments tenders.
Curated, searchable digest of AMCU appeals-board decisions grouped by typical situation — the fastest entry point into the appeals corpus and a bridge to the underlying decision documents.

Flags tenders with elevated risk of restricted competition or tailored specifications — an early-warning filter to prioritise which banking/payments procurements are likely to generate complaints, monitoring or litigation.

source_name: РАДНИК у сфері державних закупівель — практика АМКУ та ДАСУ
why_relevant: Specialist procurement-practice publisher with structured compendia of AMCU appeal-body decisions, DASU monitoring practice and deadlines. Good for terminology, procedural detail and locating decision references that are hard to search on official sites.

source_name: Вищий антикорупційний суд (ВАКС) — рішення та справи
why_relevant: The High Anti-Corruption Court adjudicates NABU/SAPO cases, which include large-value procurement corruption in state banks and state IT/payments infrastructure. Its published judgments and case lists expose contract structures and vendor relationships in exceptional detail.

source_name: НАБУ — офіційні повідомлення про розслідування (сайт + Facebook)
why_relevant: NABU publicises completed investigations, often naming state banks, procurement schemes and amounts. Recent 2025-2026 reporting shows NABU material touching state-bank governance and control (e.g. the 'Midas'/'Forest Gump' cases involving a state bank), which is directly upstream of banking-sector procurement risk.

source_name: Судова влада України — портал 'Стан розгляду справ' та відкриті дані судів
why_relevant: Central judiciary portal exposing open datasets and case-status lookups across courts; the route to case-listing metadata that complements full-text judgments when tracking ongoing procurement disputes.
